hard_preconditions: Resolve and pin the exact livekit/eot-bench-data Hugging Face revision consumed.
Resolve governing dataset license at that exact revision; do not assume benchmark-repo license applies to dataset bytes.
Create immutable manifest/hash for consumed German rows/audio/silence spans.
Bind the already source-pinned NAMO model artifact hash and exact ONNX runtime/build.
Use local execution only; outbound model/ASR/TTS provider calls must remain zero.

experiment.span_definition: all silence spans >=100ms; final span=eot, earlier spans=hold
experiment.baseline: VAD/silence-only endpoint policy on identical spans
experiment.candidate: NAMO multilingual semantic EOU on identical causal transcript context

acceptance_fence.component_value: Only if NAMO improves the German latency/false-cutoff frontier over identical VAD-only substrate without unacceptable resource cost.

return_contract: Persist exact dataset/model/runtime identities, commands, logs, per-span outputs, metric artifacts, resource measurements, hashes and negative results; return receipt path to Trigger7 for interpretation.
